# Public Guardian protocol fixture

These two public files were produced by `melloa-guardian` commit
`2006fef8b2f6deeed84da8ba8ccf03fb40672441` after a disposable Guardian moved from
`stopped` to `offline`. The private key, audit journal, and lock were removed and never entered
this repository.

This fixture proves only that Melloa can consume the signed protocol in tests and visual smoke. It
is not a deployment trust anchor, a live Guardian, or evidence of host isolation.
